versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails if the manifest, component-allowlist.json, token-catalog.json and token-policy.json disagree. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers that nothing checks automatically (the schema pins its own pageSpecVersion const independently).

sourceProject.name: Lightdash marketing site clone
sourceProject.stack: React 18.3.1 + react-router-dom 6.28.0 (BrowserRouter) + Vite 5.4.21 + Tailwind 3.4.19 + @rive-app/canvas 2.27.5 (see extraction/measured-values.json frameworkSnapshot for declared ranges; re-diffed against package.json)
sourceProject.note: The source project is a git repository (this clone). design-repo.zip is a build artifact: it stays OUT of design-repo/ and out of version control (.gitignore lists design-repo.zip; verify_all.py checks it).

visibility: PRIVATE. Do not publish: this repo describes a real, live company (Lightdash) and cites its real customers, employees, quotes, logos, compliance marks, roadmap, a live Cal.com booking calendar, a YouTube video and form endpoints (see assets/asset-roles.json licensing).

modes.clone: faithful reconstruction of the Lightdash clone; real assets and copy may be reused for fidelity
modes.generation: a new page for another brand; semantic_validate.py rejects all Lightdash identity, copy, claims, people, customers, URLs, embeds and clone-only / blocked asset roles (GENERATION_MODE_* rules)

designPolicy.contentHashScope: sha256 over the files in policy/design-policy.json enforcedBy (recomputed by verify_all.py); not over the common policy document, which is not shipped here
